summary: Frontend-only testing of CMGeorges CRM admin CRUD functionality and new pages. All 19 test cases passed successfully. Admin login works with new credentials. All 4 new admin pages (Blog, Discounts, Pricing, Policies) are accessible and functional. All CRUD modals work correctly (Create/Edit/Delete). Invoice and Quote send email buttons are present and clickable. One design inconsistency found in AdminLeads page.

ui_bugs.issue: AdminLeads page uses LIGHT theme (white background, dark text with text-[#1a365d]) while all other admin pages (Clients, Invoices, Blog, etc.) use DARK theme. This is a visual inconsistency in the admin panel.
Login page input fields and form do not have data-testid attributes (no data-testid='admin-login-form', 'admin-email-input', 'admin-password-input', 'admin-login-btn'). Minor testability issue.

issues: Leads table uses white/light background (bg-gray-50, border-gray-200) with dark navy text (text-[#1a365d]) - inconsistent with all other admin dark-themed pages
Leads page title uses text-[#1a365d] (light theme color) instead of text-white used elsewhere
The filter Card has no dark bg/border classes unlike other filter sections

action_items: Consider updating AdminLeads.jsx to use dark theme styling consistent with other admin pages (bg-gray-900, border-gray-800, text-white, text-gray-400) - optional cosmetic improvement
Add data-testid attributes to AdminLogin.jsx form inputs for better testability
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLeads.jsx: Uses light theme colors (bg-gray-50, text-[#1a365d], border-gray-200) while all other admin pages use dark theme - inconsistency in admin UI.
All Dialog/DialogContent components missing `aria-describedby` attribute - accessibility warning logged across all admin pages.
React warning: 'Received boolean for non-boolean attribute' from shadcn/ui components - non-critical but worth addressing.
AdminLeads page: `fetchLeads` function is called inside useEffect but is not wrapped in useCallback like other pages (AdminInvoices, AdminProjects) - potential stale closure issue.
seed_data_creation: Created test data during testing: 1 client (TEST Client Playwright - deleted after test), 1 blog post (Test Article Playwright), 1 discount code (TESTPLAY20), 1 pricing item (Test Service Playwright), 1 policy (Test Politique Playwright)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend CRUD operations tested and working. Login uses admin@cmgeorges.com / strongpassword123 (NOT admin123 from previous iterations - passwords were reset). All 4 new admin pages (Blog, Discounts, Pricing, Policies) accessible via sidebar under 'PARAMETRES' section. Invoice detail send button (data-testid='send-invoice-email-btn') and Quote view send button (data-testid='send-quote-email-btn') both present and clickable. AdminLeads page has light-theme styling inconsistency vs rest of dark admin UI. Leads page requires ~3 second wait after navigation for API data to load (timing-sensitive).
